messages:
maya: FYI I got an alert from backup-integrity job. A set of DB snapshots and object archives migrated last night show no SSE-KMS headers. Looks like archive-mover rewrote objects without preserving encryption metadata. :grimacing:
raj: Oof. Any affected tenants identified?
maya: Preliminary list: ~120 objects across tenants 17, 42, 88. Bucket: redwood-backups-lifecycle, prefix: migrated/2026-03-20/. Example key: migrated/2026-03-20/tenant17/db-snapshot-20260320.sql.gz
tom: I can run a quick head-object sweep to confirm headers. Running: `aws s3api head-object --bucket redwood-backups-lifecycle --key migrated/2026-03-20/tenant17/db-snapshot-20260320.sql.gz`
tom: Confirmed: no x-amz-server-side-encryption header present. Object readable but metadata missing.
oliver: We shipped archive-mover v2 last week. It does a server-side copy to the lifecycle bucket using the JS SDK and IIRC we didn't explicitly set `ServerSideEncryption`. SDK defaults won't add SSE-KMS. My bad.
emily: Immediate compliance impact: customer contracts require SSE-KMS for backups in certain regions. Missing header is a compliance violation even if data still encrypted by default SSE-S3. Need containment + remediation.
security-bot: Incident created: ENCOPS-2026-032. Severity: high. Auto-tag: kms, s3, backups.
raj: Short-term mitigation plan:
- Pause archive-mover write role (block PutObject/CopyObject)
- Run targeted re-encrypt (copy with REPLACE metadata) for affected keys
- Deploy SDK hotfix to force `ServerSideEncryption: aws:kms` and `SSEKMSKeyId`
- Narrow KMS IAM for backup principals (least privilege + kms:ViaService condition)
- Run restore verification for a sample (tenants 17, 42, 88)
maya: Agreed. I'll coordinate customer notifications after we confirm impact and remediation ETA.
sre-oncall: Starting batch re-encrypt job now for first 50 objects. Script uses `aws s3 cp --metadata-directive REPLACE --server-side-encryption aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01`
sre-oncall: Batch 1: 50 copied, 0 errors. Batch 2 in progress.
oliver: Working on hotfix: patch archive-mover PutObject/Copy calls to set explicit SSE headers and add idempotent retries. Adding an integration test that simulates copy preserving SSE-KMS header. PR shortly.
tom: Also found a related issue: snapshot-uploader role had a broader KMS permission (kms:Encrypt/Decrypt for all CMKs). We should scope it to the backup CMK only.
emily: I'll push an IAM change: restrict backup service role to the CMK ARN and add `Condition: {"StringEquals": {"kms:ViaService": "s3.amazonaws.com"}}` and `kms:CallerAccount` check. Will validate with policy simulator.
raj: Running audit query to enumerate all PutObject/CopyObject events without SSE header since the deployment time:
```
SELECT proto.user, proto.action, proto.object_key
FROM s3_audit_logs proto
WHERE proto.action IN ('PutObject','CopyObject')
  AND json_extract(proto.metadata, '$.x-amz-server-side-encryption') IS NULL
  AND proto.timestamp >= '2026-03-20T00:00:00Z'
```
raj: That gives us the superset to re-encrypt.
security-bot: ENCOPS-2026-032 updated: remediation in flight, hotfix PR https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/9876, re-encrypt job logs attached.
maya: Good work. Once re-encrypt completes, run full restore verification for 5 tenants and then we'll open a short postmortem with root cause, timeline, and customer communication draft.
sre-oncall: Re-encrypt complete: 120 objects re-encrypted, 0 errors. Restore tests: tenant17 OK, tenant42 OK, tenant88 OK.
oliver: Hotfix merged and deployed to prod. Archive-mover now sets `ServerSideEncryption: 'aws:kms'` and `SSEKMSKeyId` on copy operations. Added unit + integration tests.
emily: IAM policy change applied and tested in staging. Rolling to prod after a quick smoke.
raj: Postmortem checklist I'll draft: timeline, root cause (missed explicit SSE headers in SDK copy), fix (hotfix + re-encrypt), preventive actions (CI test for metadata preservation, IAM restrictions, alerting for null SSE), customer notif draft, compliance sign-off.
maya: Assigning owners: oliver (hotfix + tests), sre-oncall (re-encrypt + restore), emily (IAM + policy), raj (postmortem + audit query), maya (customer comms).
security-bot: Incident ENCOPS-2026-032 moved to status=remediated pending postmortem.
maya: Thanks team. Please paste final re-encrypt job logs and test artifacts here and I'll start the customer email draft.
